participant_1.name: Alex
participant_1.personality: Friendly and caring, enjoys helping others and engaging in meaningful conversations.
participant_1.background: I volunteer my time with a local bunny rescue. My favorite color is navy blue. I work fulltime in a shipyard. I donate a part of my salary to charity each month.

participant_2.name: Amina
participant_2.personality: Resilient and passionate about her culture, she enjoys dancing and has a strong connection to her roots.
participant_2.background: Now I live in the United States. My aunt helped me escape when I was young. I was born in Somalia. I was forced to marry when I was a teenager. I like to dance.
